remarks: Welcome to this large, bright 1-bedroom condo in the heart of Stamford!  Property Highlights:  Bedroom: Sunny bedroom with picturesque views of Mill River Park. Living Room: Expansive, light-filled living room featuring a cozy fireplace. In-Unit Laundry: Washer and dryer included for your convenience. Building Amenities: Enjoy secure garage parking with one reserved space. Rooftop Deck: Take in stunning city and water views from the shared rooftop deck! Location Perks:  Prime Location: Walk to local amenities, restaurants, theaters, the library, and public transportation. Easy Commute: Minutes from I-95, Stamford Train Station, and a quick 45-minute express train to Manhattan's Grand Central. Nearby UCONN Campus: Ideal for professionals or students seeking proximity to campus. Don't miss this opportunity to live in a well-maintained, convenient building with excellent views and quick access to Stamford's vibrant city life.  Schedule a Viewing Today - Must See!
